messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Halfway through shoveling, I got '' Living on a Prayer '' stuck in my head.

output.original_text: Halfway through shoveling, I got '' Living on a Prayer '' stuck in my head.
output.joy: Halfway through shoveling, I was thrilled when '' Living on a Prayer '' popped into my head!
output.sadness: Halfway through shoveling, I couldn't shake off the melancholy of '' Living on a Prayer '' playing in my mind.
output.fear: Halfway through shoveling, I felt a chill when '' Living on a Prayer '' unexpectedly crept into my thoughts.
output.anger: Halfway through shoveling, I was so irritated that '' Living on a Prayer '' wouldn't leave my head!
output.surprise: Halfway through shoveling, I was surprised when I suddenly had '' Living on a Prayer '' stuck in my head.
output.disgust: Halfway through shoveling, I felt a wave of disgust when '' Living on a Prayer '' intruded my thoughts.
